text:
lena: Quick convo: exploring a compact first-run rail that shows a sample project preview (title + 1-line blurb) with a tiny thumbnail and a CTA. Inline vs brief modal? Want opinions on copy and accessibility. sam: Inline rail better for discovery. Modal interrupts flow. Keep it permissive: users can ignore and continue. diego: Agree inline. Copy options: 'Open sample project', 'Use sample', 'Try this sample'. Prefer short verbs. lena: Which verb feels least like it spins up infra? 'Open' sounds lightweight. 'Use' might imply overwriting. jess: Microcopy: add clarifying subtext: 'This creates a demo workspace you can delete later.' helps reduce hesitation. aria-checker-bot: Accessibility note: thumbnail contrast currently 2.2:1 on gray background — fails WCAG AA for non-text UI components. Recommend >=3:1 per guidance for icons. diego: Let's switch thumbnail stroke to solid and bump to #1b2340 on white strip. That should help. Also add alt text: alt="Sample: Todo assistant project". sam: Keyboard: ensure the rail item is reachable via tab order ahead of dense nav elements. Consider a skip link anchor 'Skip to quickstart' for screen reader users. lena: On copy tests: propose A: 'Open sample project' B: 'Try sample project' C: 'Preview sample' — measure clicks and downstream project creation. jess: Also test subcopy variants: 'Create a disposable demo workspace' vs 'Try a prebuilt example'. diego: Note on CTA prominence: if rail is persistent, make CTA secondary visually (bordered) and primary CTA for new users still 'Create project' in header. We don't want to cannibalize the main funnel. aria-checker-bot: VoiceOver tip: ensure aria-label includes sample name. Use role="button" and aria-describedby to reference the subcopy so screen readers read context. lena: UX concern: users might expect the thumbnail to be clickable for a preview modal. We could open a small overlay with more details rather than a full modal that traps focus. sam: Overlay should be non-blocking: focus returns to rail after closing, and we announce status changes when provisioning:
Sample ready
. jess: Telemetry: capture quickstart_impression, quickstart_click, quickstart_preview, quickstart_create. Add cohort for new signups vs returning. diego: Implementation notes for engineers: thumbnail size 48x48, hit target >=40px, aria-label on image, CTA accessible name = "Open sample project: Todo assistant". lena: OK action items: diego will update assets and contrast; sam adds skip-link and tab order doc; jess wires telemetry; i'll write the A/B spec and sample copy variants. Share PR in #product when ready. ETA next Weds. sam: One more: avoid emojis as primary affordances. They don't always render consistently in emails or assistive tech. lena: Thanks all. Short checklist pinned: inline rail, thumbnail contrast >=3:1, CTA label explicit, alt/aria labels present, skip-link, overlay preview not trap focus, telemetry events instrumented. :white_check_mark:
